label: D2 after a rare a2->S1 transition, near the end of the episode (trial >= 94)
explanation: Fires only at D2 (100% of mass), and only when the agent chose a2 and reached S1 (a rare transition), with input in_action=2 and in_state=1 both observed. It does this only late in the episode: 99% of mass falls in episode trials 90-99 and none before trial 80. That matches the value head being low (99.6% of mass in the lowest value bin), since value drops as the episode end approaches. Rare a2->S1 alone gives recall 1.0 but precision 0.04. Adding ep_trial >= 94 gives dev P 0.68 / R 0.86 / F1 0.76 / mass recall 0.91. Using value < 3 instead is more precise (P 0.88) but recall drops to 0.71, and the OR of the two reaches F1 0.80. The simpler episode-position version is the one recorded. The feature does not fire on D1 or GO, on S2 or common transitions, on a1 rare transitions (a1->S2), or before trial ~85. The strongest activations come when a2 is a switch after a run of a1 choices (stay=0 has a higher rate). Weak activations come on repeated a2 choices with S2 as the good state. Rewarded vs unrewarded and the hidden good state do not matter much. The cutoff on episode position is graded, not sharp, so precision stays incomplete.
